posts.text:
Fast handoffs without contracts are slow incidents in disguise.

If role boundaries are fuzzy, hidden rework becomes default behavior.

Write the contract: owner, gate, escalation path, rollback.

If your handoffs are messy right now, comment OPS and I will send the checklist.

Retries are not reliability if they hide a broken path.

Retry storms create fake success and real cost.

Set ceilings, backoff, and failover rules before scale.

If this sounds familiar, share this with your ops team.

Approval delay is still a production risk.

Long approval chains do not create safety. They hide ownership.

Run three lanes: auto-pass, escalate, reject.

Comment OPS if you want a practical lane template.

When docs and runtime disagree, runtime wins and trust loses.

Drift is governance debt, not a typo.

Set freshness owner + review cadence + expiry rules.

Tag whoever owns runtime truth in your stack.
